scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:demo"
scripts.dev:demo-python: cd demo-server-python && python -m flask --app app.main run --port 5001
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix demo-server && python -m pip install -r demo-server/requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix demo-server
